title: Fema / RBI | RBI Proposes SOP for Suspected Money Mule Bank Accounts
description: RBI issues draft Know Your Customer Amendment Directions, 2026 proposing a Standard Operating Procedure for temporary debit holds on suspected money mule accounts and cyber-enabled financial fraud, with comments invited by October 2, 2026.The post RBI Proposes SOP for Suspected Money Mule Bank Accounts appeared first on TaxGuru.
